description: Durable PostgreSQL-backed task core for C (P3-1, ADR 0017): transactional accept (task + idempotency + outbox commit together before 'accepted'), optimistic-concurrency transitions bound to (tenantId, scopeId, taskId, expectedRevision), persisted pending-input decisions, checklist delivery gate (C-T01) and stale/cross-scope/role/concurrency rejections (C-T02), plus an outbox relay with consumer-side dedupe. Tests run against an embedded real PostgreSQL instance.
name: @infosec/platform-pg

scripts.pretest: npm --prefix ../contracts run build && npm --prefix ../platform run build && tsc -b .
